explication: Docling converts user-supplied documents into a unified DoclingDocument, then exports structured representations for downstream AI workflows. The main route is CLI or Python API → format backend → selected pipeline → parsing and model stages → document model → export or chunking. PDF understanding, VLM conversion, OCR, audio/video transcription, remote inference, and service-client usage are represented. Exact internal call wiring is only partially sampled, so optional integrations and some stage links are shown conservatively.
